Where each figure came from

Nothing on this sheet was typed by hand. Eight fields come off the order, four are asked when the card is made, and the rest is arithmetic.

From the orderOrder no, client code, order date, product code, drawing no, punching, quantity, tube material, plating, remark
Asked when making the cardASMBLY, fixture type, dispatch date, total length off the drawing
Total length34" on the drawing + 0.7" allowance = 34.7"
Tube draw20.0% — SS / Incoloy at 34.7"
Wire gauge30 SWG at 45.5% wire draw, the only self-consistent answer; 9 spool(s) of it fit the spring window
Cold zone2" — the policy standard for a 34.7" element
Terminal pin4" set by hand — a 2" cold zone gives 3"
Ohms after draw230² ÷ 750 = 70.5333 Ω, ±5%
Quantity100 pcs over 2 cards (50 + 50 = 100 pcs) — no card runs more than 50

What the engine flagged

These ride with the draft for the owner to clear before the card is approved.

  • Terminal pin big forced to 4" — a 2" cold zone gives 3".
  • Terminal pin small forced to 4" — a 2" cold zone gives 3".
